evidence: ICP converged at only fitness=0.653 with inlier RMSE=43.694 mm (~18x the 2.44 mm point spacing), and the resulting M3C2 deviations are huge and mostly out of tolerance (std=140.239 mm, p95=348.262 mm, only 19.4% within 5 mm, deviation_class="Insufficient"), so the co-registration is unreliable and the deviation metrics are not meaningful despite the misleading registration_ok=true flag.
